becomeHost.heroTitle: Grow Your Income With Your Space
becomeHost.heroSubtitle: Turn your house, apartment, or villa into a sustainable income stream. UrbanNest partners with you with intuitive management tools and comprehensive Host protection.
becomeHost.unverifiedEmailDesc: Please verify your email address before applying to become a Host.
becomeHost.trustCardDesc: Comprehensive coverage of up to 2 billion VND per stay
becomeHost.benefitsSubtitle: We empower property owners with market-leading hospitality tools
becomeHost.benefit1Desc: Track detailed cash flow and receive automated bank transfers 24 hours after guest check-in.
becomeHost.benefit2Desc: Guest identity verification, transparent two-way reviews, and an exclusive incident protection guarantee.
becomeHost.benefit3Desc: Connect with discerning domestic and international travelers seeking authentic local accommodations.
becomeHost.howItWorksHeading: 4 Simple Steps to Welcome Your First Guest
becomeHost.howItWorksSubtitle: A streamlined onboarding process designed for speed and convenience
becomeHost.step1Desc: Provide your identity documents and proof of property operating rights.
becomeHost.step2Desc: Upload high-res photos, describe your space, and set amenities and cancellation rules.
becomeHost.step3Desc: Leverage smart pricing suggestions to optimize your occupancy and revenue.
becomeHost.step4Desc: Hand over keys to travelers and receive direct earnings on schedule.
becomeHost.preparationSubtitle: Have the following ready to speed up your verification review
becomeHost.prepDoc1Desc: Valid original government ID, with all 4 corners visible on both sides.
becomeHost.prepDoc2Desc: Ownership deed, commercial lease agreement permitting sublease, or power of attorney.
becomeHost.faqSubtitle: Everything you need to know before starting your hosting journey
becomeHost.faq1Q: Does it cost anything to sign up as a Host?
becomeHost.faq1A: Zero upfront fees! Creating an account and listing your space is 100% free. We only charge a modest service fee per successful reservation.
becomeHost.faq2A: Our compliance review team evaluates applications within 24 to 48 business hours. You'll receive email notification upon completion.
becomeHost.faq3A: Yes! You have full control over your house rules, guest requirements, and can manually review each booking request.
